audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no real cooldown numbers, and dosFull[1].d / dontsFull[2].d were verbatim copies of tradeGood/tradeBad pasted under unrelated titles instead of content grounded in Ezreal's kit.
audit.why: lintFindings flags COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT and two COPY_PASTE_BLEED entries.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now cites Arcane Shift (26-14s), Sivir E (24-18s), and R (120/105/90s); dosFull[1].d now keys off Mystic Shot's 5.5-4.5s cooldown for the Spell Shield bait, and dontsFull[2].d now matches its 'Shove without river vision' title.

edits.before: - Ezreal Arcane Shift: matchup-defining — The blink makes him untouchable — punish the nineteen seconds after he burns it. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Spell Shield has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Ezreal Arcane Shift (26-14s CD): the blink makes him untouchable — punish the window right after he burns it, longest at rank 1. - Your E Spell Shield (24-18s CD) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The 120/105/90s R has one too: the moment it all goes right.

edits.before: Q the contact both ways, W-bounce the duo, walk — the trade taxed two people and refunded your mana bar.
edits.after: Bank the E for a well-timed Mystic Shot (5.5-4.5s CD) — a blocked bolt refunds him nothing and denies the poke.

edits.before: Spending E on chip damage and eating the engage it existed to eat — the shield is the matchup; spend it like a verdict.
edits.after: Shoving without vision into his Arcane Shift range just feeds him a free reposition — check the bush before you push.
